oral_examination.oral_examination: 33 degrees looseness, no abnormality in the buccal mucosa, red and swollen gums, otherwise normal. CBCT shows: Alveolar bone has been absorbed to the apical 1/3 of the root, and the apex is a low-density image.

source_handle: 33 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local disinfection with iodophor, local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine, extraction of the affected tooth, scraping of granulation tissue, implantation of iodoform gauze strips in the extraction socket, and cotton ball compression to stop bleeding.
